rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=80, pretrain_lr=0.0001, itnet_k=1, itnet_alpha=0.005, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=579, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-10 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric) for itnet = ItNet v1 (pretrain-denoiser-then-FIXED-DC k=1, solver_itnet.py). BOARD CHAMPION hr 0.4344 @iter-9. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, not CT pixels). (1) TRAJECTORY (val=ALL 214 L277, 321px FOV; hr=metric of record): iter-6 itnet_k 3->1 BROKE THE FLOOR SSIM 0.9332/hr 0.3752 (tn200 ep200); iter-7 train_n 200->300 hr 0.3990 (ep125); iter-8 train_n 300->480 hr 0.4143 (ep80); iter-9 train_n 480->579 FULL POOL hr 0.4344 (SSIM 0.9447, ep66, 38214 grad steps, elapsed 980.4s). train_n is now MAXED at the full 579-slice train pool -> the data-coverage lever is EXHAUSTED (iters 6-9 deliberately held epochs at grad-step-parity to ISOLATE data coverage). (2) LIMITER: with data maxed, the remaining axis is DENOISER CONVERGENCE. itnet v1 main() trains ONLY the SmallUNet denoiser (params_M 0.2329) via pretrain_epochs on FBP->truth pairs, then a pure-inference k=1 DC unroll. iters 6-9 ran epochs in diminishing-returns / parity (ep200->125->80->66), so MORE convergence at the FULL 579 pool is UNTESTED on v1. (3) ONE KNOB: pretrain_epochs 66 -> 80 (+14 epochs = +8120 grad steps on the full pool), from BASE_ITER=9. KEEP itnet_k=1 (the breakthrough) and train_n=579 (MAXED). All else identical to iter-9 (itnet_alpha=0.005, unet_c=16, pretrain_lr=1e-4, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). (4) HYPOTHESIS: more denoiser convergence on the full pool lifts hr ABOVE 0.4344 (the prior PURGED campaign found itnet v1 epochs DOMINANT with an ep104 peak), predict ~0.436-0.440. FALSIFIER (operative, NUMERIC): if hr <= 0.4344 at ep80/tn579/k=1, denoiser convergence SATURATES at the full pool -> 0.4344 is the v1 budget-constrained CEILING; document it toward iter-20 (next axis would be capacity unet_c or alpha, both flat on sibling itnet_v2 at full pool). Honest read: likely near-ceiling -- sibling itnet_v2 tried ep-up at full pool and it was flat/budget-capped. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score; sbatch 30-min wall is the only hard fence): iter-9 ACTUAL 980.4s @ ep66/tn579 (38214 grad steps). Marginal pretrain cost ~0.0208 s/grad-step + fixed ~185s (data load + 214-slice per-sample val + figure + startup). iter-10 ep80/tn579 = 46320 grad steps -> 0.0208*46320 = 963s + 185s fixed = ~1148s = 19.1 min, INSIDE the 1200s HARD wall with ~52s margin (and the marginal-cost model is conservative vs iter-9 blended 0.02565 s/gs). val stays ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (default; NO fov= override). grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory: the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside the DC step overflows otherwise). v1 has NO max_train_s backstop. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (each val slice swaps itnet.projector to its own ps; chunk=1 FORCED), bg_target=truth, KEEP itnet_k=1, train_n=579, val=ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; NO fov= override).
